industry.zh: 企业级基础模型与人工智能软件
industry.en: Enterprise foundation models and AI software

tagline.zh: 面向企业环境提供 AI 模型与应用能力。
tagline.en: Models and AI applications built for enterprise use.

overview.zh: Cohere 于 2019 年创立于多伦多，开发面向企业的基础语言模型和人工智能应用产品，强调可部署性、隐私和业务场景适配。
overview.en: Founded in Toronto in 2019, Cohere develops foundation language models and AI solutions for businesses, with emphasis on deployment flexibility, privacy and real-world applications.

overview.zh: 其官方产品覆盖文本生成、检索与企业知识工作流。企业用户可以在不同云与私有环境中部署支持的模型。
overview.en: Its portfolio supports text generation, retrieval and enterprise knowledge workflows, including deployment options across cloud and supported private environments.

description.zh: 服务企业应用的语言模型
description.en: Language models for enterprise applications

description.zh: 用于文本嵌入与语义检索
description.en: Text embeddings and semantic retrieval

industry.en: Expert talent networks and AI training services

tagline.zh: 连接专业人才与人工智能研究所需的知识工作。
tagline.en: Connecting human expertise with AI development.

overview.zh: Mercor 创立于 2023 年，最初开发 AI 辅助人才评估与匹配平台，后来扩展到连接领域专家与 AI 实验室、企业之间的知识工作。
overview.en: Founded in 2023, Mercor began with AI-assisted candidate evaluation and matching and expanded into connecting domain experts with AI labs and enterprises.

overview.zh: 其业务涉及专家筛选、项目匹配、专业知识收集和模型评估。与 HHBA 的平台定位可能有相似之处，但两者不存在已知合作关系。
overview.en: Its work includes expert screening, project matching, knowledge contribution and model evaluation. Some activities resemble HHBA's talent focus but no business partnership is implied.

description.zh: 根据专业能力连接项目需求
description.en: Connect expertise with project demand

overview.zh: Cognition 是开发 Devin AI 编程产品的美国人工智能企业。Devin 被定位为能够围绕代码库执行开发任务、使用工具及报告结果的软件工程 AI Agent。
overview.en: Cognition is a US AI company behind Devin, an AI software engineering agent designed to work with codebases, use development tools and report task results.

overview.zh: 其产品面向软件研发团队，关注从任务描述到代码实现的工作流程。由于企业成立年份没有在本批所用官方资料中独立核实，HHBA 不显示猜测年份。
overview.en: Its products address workflows from issue descriptions to software implementation. As the company founding year was not independently confirmed from the sources used in this batch, HHBA does not invent a date.

industry.en: Cashback, commerce rewards and shopping platform

tagline.zh: 通过购物返现连接消费者与商户。
tagline.en: Shopping rewards connecting customers and merchants.

overview.zh: ShopBack 于 2014 年创立于新加坡，运营购物返现和优惠服务平台，让消费者经由其应用或网站访问合作商家并获得合规适用的奖励。
overview.en: Founded in Singapore in 2014, ShopBack operates a cashback and shopping rewards service connecting consumers with participating merchants through its site and app.

overview.zh: 其业务也为商户提供营销触达、返现激励与合作推广工具，覆盖多个市场；实际优惠与返现规则依据当地服务条件。
overview.en: Its merchant services include performance marketing, rewards and campaign partnerships across multiple markets; actual benefits depend on local terms.

description.en: Conditional cashback on eligible purchases

industry.en: Security compliance automation and trust management

tagline.zh: 帮助企业持续验证并展示安全控制。
tagline.en: Continuous security evidence and trust management.

overview.zh: Vanta 创立于 2018 年，开发信息安全合规与信任管理平台，帮助企业整理证据、跟踪安全控制并为审计做准备。
overview.en: Founded in 2018, Vanta builds security compliance and trust-management software that helps companies collect evidence, monitor controls and prepare for audits.

overview.zh: 其产品覆盖 SOC 2、ISO 27001 等管理标准的准备过程，也涉及供应商风险、信任中心和客户问卷。是否通过认证由独立审核机构确定，软件不能自行颁发认证。
overview.en: Its software supports workflows for frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, vendor risk, trust centers and questionnaires. Certification is determined by independent assessors, not by the tool itself.

overview.zh: Ashby 团队于 2018 年开始构建招聘技术平台，为企业人才团队提供岗位管理、候选人追踪、面试排期以及招聘分析能力。
overview.en: Ashby's team started building its recruiting platform in 2018, providing applicant tracking, interview scheduling and recruiting analytics for talent teams.

overview.zh: HHBA 索引的部分海外职位通过 Ashby 公开 Job Board 发布。Ashby 是技术服务平台，不表示所有使用 Ashby 招聘系统的企业与 HHBA 或 Ashby 存在联合招聘。

overview.en: AlphaSights facilitates expert interactions and knowledge services for decision-makers. HHBA preserves the campus board's source identity for job accuracy while attributing the company background to AlphaSights.

overview.zh: General Robotics 是一家从事机器人 AI 研究和部署的企业，其官方介绍关注让不同形态机器人具备更通用的感知、规划和行动能力。公开招聘板列示团队在美国华盛顿州雷德蒙德的岗位。
overview.en: General Robotics develops and deploys robotics AI, focusing on adaptable perception, planning and action across different robot types. Its public recruiting board lists positions in Redmond, Washington.

overview.zh: 公司公开展示 GRID 机器人智能平台，将基础模型、仿真和机器人技能结合。成立年份尚缺可直接确认的正式来源，故本页不猜测。

overview.zh: “SpaceX Global” 是 Greenhouse 上的 SpaceX 国际职位招聘板标识，其公开页面以“Current openings at SpaceX”为标题，主要列示 Starlink 国际销售、供应链及相关业务职位。
overview.en: “SpaceX Global” is a Greenhouse recruiting board label for SpaceX international roles. The public board identifies openings at SpaceX, including Starlink international sales and supply chain positions.

overview.zh: HHBA 保留该独立招聘来源记录，方便按原始岗位来源筛选，但不宣称 SpaceX Global 是独立法人，也不单独编造成立年份；公司背景应参考 SpaceX 官方资料。
overview.en: HHBA keeps the separate board identity for accurate job matching, without claiming a separate corporation or inventing a founding year. Company context comes from official SpaceX materials.

tagline.zh: 通过软件连接患者、治疗师与医疗保险支付体系。
tagline.en: Connecting patients, therapists and insurance through software.

overview.zh: Headway 于 2019 年推出，致力于降低美国心理健康服务的费用与预约门槛。其平台帮助患者寻找可接受保险的心理健康专业人士。
overview.en: Launched in 2019, Headway aims to reduce barriers to mental healthcare in the US by helping patients find providers who accept insurance.

overview.zh: 平台还帮助治疗师管理保险资格认证、理赔、支付与诊所运营。医疗服务由相关专业人士提供，HHBA 仅描述科技平台背景，不提供医疗建议。
overview.en: The platform also helps therapists with credentialing, insurance claims, payments and practice operations. Care is provided by licensed professionals; HHBA presents company context, not medical guidance.
